# Interactive Data Lab (IDL)

> > Research lab at the University of Washington developing tools and techniques for interactive data visualization, including Draco, flechette, and D3.js educational resources.

The Interactive Data Lab focuses on making data visualization more accessible and effective through constraint-based design systems, high-performance data processing libraries for Apache Arrow, and comprehensive tutorials for web-based visualization technologies.

## Key Topics

- Data Visualization
- D3.js
- JavaScript
- Draco (constraint-based visualization)
- flechette (Apache Arrow)
- Interactive Tools
- HTML/CSS/SVG
- Color Perception
- Cross-linguistic Studies
- Vega-Lite
- Web Technologies
- DOM Manipulation
- University of Washington
- Dominik Moritz
- Kanit Wongsuphasawat

## Core Projects & Tools

- [Draco](https://idl.uw.edu/draco): Constraint-based visualization design framework using ASP and Vega-Lite

## flechette API Reference

- [Data Types API Reference](https://idl.uw.edu/flechette/api/data-types.html): Flechette data types API for Apache Arrow JavaScript mapping
- [Schema API Reference](https://idl.uw.edu/flechette/api/schema): Flechette schema API reference for Arrow field objects and metadata
- [Table API Reference](https://idl.uw.edu/flechette/api/table): Flechette table API for column operations and data extraction

## D3.js Tutorials & Learning Resources

- [Technology Fundamentals for D3](https://idl.uw.edu/d3-tutorials/fundamental.html): D3.js tutorial covering HTML, CSS, SVG, and JavaScript fundamentals

## Research & Interactive Visualizations

- [Hue Color Comparisons - Color Naming in Different Languages](https://idl.uw.edu/color-naming-in-different-languages/vis/stacked-spectrum.html): Interactive visualization comparing color naming across languages
